summary: UBS Group AG filed its standalone interim financial information on Form 6-K for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing includes income statement and balance sheet data, with dividend income from subsidiaries, operating income, expenses, and net profit. It reports total assets of $206.4 billion and equity of $69.8 billion as of June 30, 2026. The document is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer, providing an update on financial performance and position. It does not announce any special corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing is made as a regulatory obligation under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
